title: Community Resource Center (CRC)
tagline: The Physical & Cultural Heart of LGBTQ+ Ventura County
audience: All LGBTQIA+ individuals, families, youth, seniors, and allies
summary: A safe, welcoming, and affirming physical space in Ventura providing drop-in peer groups, free computer lab access, a curated lending library, harm reduction supplies, and community connections.
description: Our Community Resource Center (CRC) provides a safe space for the LGBTQIA+ community of Ventura County. Our staff and volunteers support the health and wellness of the most marginalized, advocate for equality and justice through civic engagement, and work to build a culturally rich community through various groups and classes.
amenities: Drop-in LGBTQ+ social lounge & community space
Free computer and printer access for job/resource searching
Curated LGBTQ+ lending library & educational archive
Free safer sex supplies, hygiene products & harm reduction kits
Dedicated meeting room for peer groups and partner organizations
Private consultation rooms for health screenings and intake
